commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+6' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
90+4' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) takes a short corner kick.

90+4' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Good work from Arsenal as they win a corner.
90+1' Bart Verbruggen leaps to intercept the corner kick from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal).
90+1' A cross from Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Arsenal earn a corner.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Piero Hincapie (Arsenal) attempts to delay the restart of play. The referee doesn't like it. The referee is firm and issues Piero Hincapie (Arsenal) a deserved yellow card.
88' Corner kicks – 5:2.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tom Watson (Brighton) comes onto the pitch so that Diego Coppola can be given a rest.
87' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to make a change. Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton) replaces Diego Gomez.
86' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) inside the box.
85' CHANCE! Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) fires just over the crossbar from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Bukayo Saka.
84' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
83' Declan Rice (Arsenal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.
83' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
83' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
82' The manager makes a subsitution with Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) coming on for Leandro Trossard.
79' David Raya (Arsenal) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
78' The game is interrupted now, David Raya (Arsenal) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
77' Ferdi Kadioglu sends over a penetrating corner which finds the head of Mats Wieffer (Brighton), but his effort from close range is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
77' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

77' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the top left corner. However, David Raya anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. Brighton force their opponents to concede a corner.
76' Brighton keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
75' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
75' It will be a substitution. Danny Welbeck (Brighton) is ready to enter the pitch as Jack Hinshelwood walks off.
71' Here is a change. Viktor Gyökeres is going off and Mikel Arteta gives the last tactical orders to Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal).
71' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Myles Lewis-Skelly as he is replaced by Gabriel (Arsenal).

69' Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal) obviously intended to delay the restart of play and the referee blows the whistle. Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
68' 18:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. 6:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
66' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
64' 2 - 1 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Diego Gomez (Brighton), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 2:1.
64' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the left post. Close!
62' Declan Rice (Arsenal) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
61' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball is out of play. Arsenal win a corner kick.
60' Great save! Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Bart Verbruggen.
58' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Yasin Ayari (Brighton).
57' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) offside.
56' Declan Rice (Arsenal) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
56' Diego Coppola (Brighton) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
55' The ball is cleared out of defence to the edge of the box where Yasin Ayari (Brighton) hits a first-time shot back towards goal. Unfortunately for him, the ball flashes well past the left post.
52' 2 - 0 Georginio Rutter (Brighton) attempts to head the ball away from inside the six-yard box, but unluckily he turns a cross from the resulting corner into the top right corner of his own net.
52' Declan Rice (Arsenal) will take the corner.

52' This shall not pass! Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Arsenal will have a chance to score from a corner.
50' This is a yellow card! Lewis Dunk (Brighton) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.

50' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but David Raya was alert and the score remained the same.

49' A through ball from Georginio Rutter (Brighton) fails to reach Yankuba Minteh as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Yankuba Minteh could have got into a promising position.
49' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
47' A pass by Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Arsenal.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Fabian Hurzeler probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton). He is replaced by Mats Wieffer.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Brajan Gruda (Brighton) comes off for Yankuba Minteh.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' John Brooks blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Declan Rice (Arsenal) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
45+1' Bart Verbruggen (Brighton) is booked.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

44' Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) receives a quality pass inside the box and fires a first-time shot. His effort towards the left post is saved by the goalkeeper. Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) misses a rebound from close range. His effort floats narrowly over the crossbar!
43' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends the corner into the box, but Bart Verbruggen intercepts it and averts the threat.
43' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Arsenal get a corner.
40' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left John Brooks no option but to blow his whistle.
37' Declan Rice (Arsenal) strikes a promising volley towards goal, but one of the defenders is quick enough to step in and make a crucial block.
37' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.

36' A cross by Declan Rice (Arsenal) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
35' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Martin Odegaard (Arsenal), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
34' Foul! Brajan Gruda (Brighton) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Arsenal earn a free kick.
33' Total attempts – 6:0. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 4:0.
32' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Bart Verbruggen.
31' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
30' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
28' Diego Gomez (Brighton) commits a foul during an attacking move.
26' Diego Gomez (Brighton) sprays a pass out to Brajan Gruda, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
24' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
23' Georginio Rutter is picked out by Yasin Ayari (Brighton), but one of the defenders arrives to clear.
23' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
22' John Brooks blows his whistle after Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. A free kick is awarded to Brighton.
22' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) plays a terrific long ball forward to Leandro Trossard, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
20' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) is adjudged offside.
17' The ball possession at the moment is 49:51.
14' 1 - 0 Goal! Bukayo Saka tees up Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
14' A fine solo run by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies high over the bar.
13' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) attacks the corner from Bukayo Saka in the centre of the box, but his header lacks accuracy and goes high over the bar.
13' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

12' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
11' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Arsenal will have a throw-in.
10' Brighton control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
8' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

7' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Brighton.
5' The ball is cleared after Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.

4' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his strike towards the right side of the target as Bart Verbruggen produces a good save.
4' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) jumps into a tackle and John Brooks signals a foul.

2' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) was waiting for the ball on the edge of the box and produced a powerful volley directed low to the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper made an amazing save to deny him.
2' Arsenal enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
